extracted.name: Candie's Simply Great Punch
extracted.description: A quick and pleasing punch whipped together with two cans of punch, a bottle of lemon-lime soda, and a tub of ice cream.
ingredient_lines: 1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
instruction_lines: Pour chilled punch and soda into a punch bowl. Scoop out an entire half-gallon of ice cream and carefully slide into punch.
